## Global error handler

This workflow is the safety net for anything the main pipeline does NOT catch on its own error branches - node crashes, expression failures, out-of-memory, or a node with no error output wired.

**To arm it:** open Podcast to Content Pipeline, go to Settings, and set Error Workflow to this workflow. Without that setting this never fires.

Classify Failure buckets the error by message pattern so the Slack alert carries a suggested next step instead of a raw stack trace.
